title: Development and external validation of a non-invasive early gestational diabetes mellitus prediction model integrating social network variables: a machine learning-based prospective cohort study.
summary: Prospective derivation cohort of 1,752 and geographically independent validation cohort of 681 pregnant participants; GDM outcomes are assessed. A machine-learning model predicts early gestational diabetes using social-network variables and conventional factors. Testing: External validation strengthens the prediction result, but generalization and clinical utility remain to be tested elsewhere..
